Variants.Content: Corner Valley City is located between the Western Valley and is the ancestral territory of the Brax family. It belongs to the Western Territory governed by Casterly Rock, and the surrounding roads pass through gold mining hills, pastures and river valleys; the purple unicorn family emblem is more commonly seen there than the flag of the distant royal capital.

Entry Hornvale Local families also relied on mining tunnels, pastures, mountain roads, gold and silver circulation and the market sheltered by Casterly Rock; if any road, well or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Hornvale If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

In Kakudani Castle, craftsmen saw stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and seams left by generations of repairs. Priests guarded the stone carvings left by the Seven Gods, family tombs, and the authority of the lords. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Hornvale They care about the mines, pastures, mountain roads, the circulation of gold and silver, and the market under the protection of Casterly Rock. They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
